name: Highway Robbery
summary: In Desolace, a pillaged campsite holds clues to a violent attack. You seek someone who can make sense of what happened.

sections.title: A Ransacked Camp
sections.body: Two humans and a dwarf lie among the remains at a campsite in Desolace. The marks on their bones point to a savage attack, while the stolen supplies show that an animal was not responsible. Their wounds do not match centaur weapons either. You are asked to find someone in Desolace who knows these lands and can explain the signs.

faq.q: Who was attacked at the campsite?
faq.answer: The remains indicate that two humans and a dwarf were attacked.
The campsite was pillaged, and the remains show signs of a savage attack.
The looted supplies suggest the attack was not done by an animal.

faq.q: Were the wounds made by centaurs?
faq.answer: The wounds do not match centaur weaponry.
You are asked to find someone in Desolace experienced in scavenging these lands.
